jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production hand-painted cel-shaded 2D game sprite sheet. Reference is EXACT CHARACTER IDENTITY, costume, and anatomical scale. Marko black moustache,long dark hair,red gold-embroidered cape,ivory embroidered sleeves,brown leather/mail armor,brown boots,spiked mace ALWAYS in RIGHT hand unless explicitly using both. Right-facing side-on platformer. IMPORTANT maintain SAME HEAD SIZE AND BODY PROPORTIONS in EVERY cell INCLUDING standing calibration; crouching or floating MUST NOT be enlarged to fill cells. Full figures/weapons in central75% of OWN cells with broad clean gutters, no cropping/crossing boundaries. Equal square slots, 3 COLUMNS by 3 ROWS, row-major. Frames1-8 action: 1 push off ONE foot from forward-leaning sprint. 2 takeoff legs separate, left arm reaches forward RIGHT, mace in RIGHT hand held behind LEFT. 3-5 fully airborne long-distance BROAD STRIDE over chasm, leading leg extended right/trailing leg back left, cape streams behind, strong forward momentum, same scale not shrunk. 6 leading leg lowers for landing. 7 both legs prepare landing. 8 pre-landing legs tucked forward, still airborne, ready touchdown. No drawn ground or chasm. Game applies vertical translation; draw poses, not large vertical movement within cells. After the action frames draw ONE neutral scale calibration pose in cell9 matching the reference standing pose exactly in anatomical size; this calibration pose is NOT part of animation.  Pure FLAT #00FF00 green in all empty space. No shadows, scenery, drawn floor, grid, text, numbers, effects or extra characters. Same painting as reference, strong readable silhouettes with smooth progression. Final cells512x512, lowest foot/body contact y487; uniform zoom compared to383px-tall idle reference. One-shot.
